info.description: Every /v1 route outside /public needs an access token. The active branch travels in the X-Branch-Id header, not in the token, and is validated per request.
info.title: Coti API

get.description: Checks no dependency, so a failing database does not restart the container.
Reports whether the process can serve traffic: both database pools answer.
Returns the corralón the caller belongs to, brand included.

put.description: Replaces the corralón's record, including the brand the client webapp renders a quote with.

post.description: Requires the current password. Ends every other session and returns a fresh token pair, so the caller stays logged in and nobody else does.

422.description: New password below the configured minimum length

post.description: Advances the session epoch and revokes the presented refresh family. The body is optional.

get.description: Every active branch of the account for an admin; the assigned ones for a seller.

post.description: Opens a branch together with its manual-entry channel, which a counter or phone order needs.

put.description: Replaces name, address and default quote expiry. is_active omitted leaves the flag alone.

delete.description: Deactivates the branch so its quotes and prices stay explainable. Refuses to close the account's last active branch.

get.description: Returns the caller's identity and branch reach, so the frontend never has to read the access token itself.
Returns an XLSX pre-filled with the prices in force for the active branch, ready to edit and re-import.

post.description: Revalidates the reviewed rows and, in one transaction, closes the current price periods and inserts the replacements.
Parses the uploaded spreadsheet and reports every row with its proposed value and errors. Writes nothing.

get.description: Ordered by name. Soft-deleted items are hidden unless include_inactive is set.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on canonical name or code
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Page size; defaults to CATALOG_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE and is capped at CATALOG_MAX_PAGE_SIZE
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Availability, stock and price are set per branch by their own endpoints.

409.description: The account already has a product with that code

put.description: Replaces the editable attributes, so an omitted nullable field clears the column. is_active is the exception.

parameters.description: Product as it should end up
parameters.name: body

409.description: The account already has a product with that code

delete.description: Soft delete: the row survives because quote and price history point at it. Repeating is harmless.

get.description: direction picks the end to read: OUTGOING what can replace this product, INCOMING what it replaces. Defaults to OUTGOING.

post.description: The product in the path is the base; type is EQUIVALENT, PREMIUM or ECONOMY.

404.description: Either product is unknown to the account

422.description: A product cannot be its own alternative

delete.description: The link is addressable from either of the two products it joins.

get.description: Returns the active branch's row when X-Branch-Id is present, every branch of the account otherwise.

parameters.description: Active branch; omit to read every branch
parameters.name: X-Branch-Id

put.description: Creates the branch's row or updates it. Deactivating stops the branch offering an item the account still catalogs.

422.description: No active branch, or a stock NUMERIC(14,2) cannot hold

get.description: Every validity period, open and closed. Scoped to X-Branch-Id when present, account-wide otherwise.

parameters.description: Active branch; omit to read every branch
parameters.name: X-Branch-Id

post.description: Opens a new validity period and closes the previous one at the same instant. min_price cannot exceed price.

422.description: No active branch, min_price above price, or valid_from before the current period

get.description: Trade vocabulary that improves lexical catalog matching.

post.description: source is MANUAL for a term a person loaded or LEARNED for one the pipeline proposed. Defaults to MANUAL.

409.description: The product already carries that term

post.description: Creates the account, its first branch with that branch's manual-entry channel, and the administrator, then returns a session.
Always answers 202, registered address or not, so the response reveals nothing about which addresses exist. Requesting a new link retires the previous one.

parameters.description: Address to send the link to
parameters.name: body

post.description: A bad email, a bad password, a disabled user and a deactivated account all answer 401 alike. The refresh token is shown exactly once.

403.description: A confirmed address is required and this one is not

429.description: Rate limit spent; retry_after_seconds says when

post.description: Replaying a consumed token inside the grace window is a benign race; past it, the whole family is revoked as theft.
Always answers 202, so the response reveals nothing about which addresses exist or which are already confirmed. Requesting a new link retires the previous one.

parameters.description: Address to send the link to
parameters.name: body

post.description: The link works once and expires. Unknown, expired and already-used tokens all answer 401 alike. Every session the user had is ended.
post.summary: Reset a password with a recovery link

422.description: New password below the configured minimum length

post.description: The link works once and expires. Unknown, expired and already-used tokens all answer 401 alike. Confirming an address that is already verified succeeds.

get.description: Admin only. Ordered by name, deactivated users included so they can be re-enabled.

post.description: Admin only. The account comes from the session; a duplicate email inside it is a 409.

put.description: Admin only. Replaces the profile; is_active omitted leaves the flag alone.

delete.description: Admin only. Keeps the row so their quotes keep an author, and revokes their tokens at once.

post.description: Admin only, and only within the caller's own account. Sends the user the same single-use link they would request themselves, so the administrator never sees a password.
post.summary: Trigger a password reset for a user

stock.description: decimal string; null when the branch does not track it.

detail.description: set when a body failed binding or validation.
